data.content:
I submitted the dispute for DD-48267 for owner approval. It asks for a review and reversal of the $16.50 "missing item" deduction.

The first submission failed the wording check because "applied" contains the flagged string "lied". I changed it to "taken" and resubmitted once, and it passed.

The dispute cites the ticket listing the Peanut Butter Bowl and the pickup timing (ready 12:52, picked up 12:55). It says plainly that nothing records what was in the bag. I left out the repeat-claims evidence because it would reflect on the customer.
